children: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd. has received two Letters of Intent (LOIs) that are together worth ₹230.58 crore from JSW Rail Infra Logistics and JSW (South) Rail Logistics for the manufacture and supply of 553 wagons.
The first LOI, worth ₹102.57 crore including taxes, is from JSW Rail Infra Logistics for 246 wagons including BFNSM1 and BVCM wagons.
The second order was placed by JSW (South) Rail Logistics for 307 wagons comprising BFNSM1 and BVCM wagons. It is worth ₹128.01 crore including taxes.
Texmaco Rail will execute the first order by February 2027 and the second by May 2027, according to its regulatory filing.
No promoter or promoter groups interest in the entities awarding the orders, and the contracts do not fall under related-party transactions, the company clarified.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering ended at ₹111.37 apiece on the NSE on Friday, November 20, up 0.37% for the day.

title: Texmaco Rail gets ₹230 crore orders from JSW entities for 553 wagons
